usage: run_quality_eval.py [-h] [--dataset {vctk,librispeech}]
                           [--split {train,val,test}]
                           [--telephony_codec {none,opus,g711}]
                           [--telephony_codec_bitrate TELEPHONY_CODEC_BITRATE]
                           [--max_utts MAX_UTTS] [--seed SEED]
                           [--telephony_config TELEPHONY_CONFIG]
                           [--eval_config EVAL_CONFIG]
                           [--defense_checkpoint DEFENSE_CHECKPOINT]

Quality eval: WER + STOI under telephony (utter-level, VCTK test).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dataset {vctk,librispeech}
  --split {train,val,test}
  --telephony_codec {none,opus,g711}
  --telephony_codec_bitrate TELEPHONY_CODEC_BITRATE
  --max_utts MAX_UTTS
  --seed SEED
  --telephony_config TELEPHONY_CONFIG
  --eval_config EVAL_CONFIG
  --defense_checkpoint DEFENSE_CHECKPOINT
                        v0p1_B checkpoint; empty = baseline only in one run
